text: dsh-mermaid 是 DSH Web 插件，可将聊天消息中的 Mermaid 代码围栏渲染为图表。它通过 Web 客户端扫描代码块，在内容定稿后调用 Mermaid 渲染，并在代码块卡片中加入图表与源码切换按钮。图表会随浅色或深色主题重绘，语法错误时保留源码并显示错误提示；流式内容完成前仍显示普通代码。适合希望直接在 DSH 网页聊天中查看流程图的用户。代码中未发现需要配置 API 密钥或外部账号的设置。

dsh-mermaid renders settled Mermaid code fences as diagrams in DSH web chats. A toggle switches between diagram and source, and diagrams follow the page theme. Streaming blocks remain code; syntax errors keep the source visible with a note. It helps users view flowcharts in chat without API keys.

聊天中渲染 Mermaid 图：定稿的 Mermaid 代码围栏会被解析并显示为 SVG 图表；内容仍在流式生成时会暂留为普通代码。
切换图表与源码视图：渲染成功后，代码块卡片中的按钮可在图表和原始代码之间切换，复制按钮仍可用于源码。
适配主题并呈现错误：网页切换深浅主题时会重新渲染图表；若 Mermaid 解析失败，插件保留代码并在下方显示错误提示。
dsh-mermaid README · dsh-mermaid：A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web GUI plugin that renders ```` ```mermaid ```` code fences in chat messages as diagrams.

dsh-mermaid README · dsh-mermaid：- Settled mermaid fences show the diagram inside the stock code-block card. A toggle button in the card header ("Show code" / "Show diagram") switches between the diagram and its source. The Copy button still copies the source.
- Fences that are still streaming stay as plain code until the message settles.
- Diagrams re-render when DSH switches between light and dark (`document.documentElement.style.colorScheme`).
- If a diagram has a syntax error, the code stays visible with a muted `Mermaid: <error>` line under it.
- mermaid (v12, `securityLevel: 'strict'`) lives in a lazy chunk, `lib/client.mermaid.js`, so it loads only after the first mermaid fence appears. Page boot loads only the small `lib/client.js`.

text: dsh-mermaid README · How it detects mermaid fences：DSH renders every fence through a React `CodeBlock` component with root `div.md-code-block`. For mermaid the visible label is the generic "Code block", so the language is not in the DOM. The plugin reads it from React's fiber props instead: it takes the element's `__reactFiber$…` fiber, walks up at most 4 levels, and uses the first `memoizedProps` that has string `code` and `lang` fields (`src/fiber.ts`). The same props carry `streaming`. When a message settles, the DOM may not change at all, so a MutationObserver can miss it. While any mermaid block is still streaming, the plugin also rescans every 500 ms.

dsh-mermaid README · How it detects mermaid fences：A DOM node keeps the fiber it was created with. After every other commit, that fiber is the stale alternate. So the plugin reads the props chain of both the fiber and its alternate. It keeps the props whose `code` matches the text React rendered into `[data-code-block-content] code`, and if both match, it prefers the settled one.

dsh-mermaid README · How it detects mermaid fences：The per-block logic is a pure state machine in `src/fence.ts`. Its states are waiting, rendering, rendered and failed. It is idempotent per (code, theme), and it drops stale render completions.

Nothing reads a live `~/.dsh` or `~/.dsh-tui`; set `DSH_BIN`, `DSH_ROOT`, `DSH_TUI_DIR` and `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH` to pinned store builds (see `flake.nix`'s devShell) and run the suites via `nix develop`. `MMD_INSTALL` picks how the web and TUI suites install the plugin (`test/install.ts`): `row` (default, an explicit `lib/index.js` row as nix-config writes it), `link` (`dsh plugin add link:<checkout>`) or `tarball` (`dsh plugin add` of the `pnpm pack` output).

dsh-mermaid README · Nix：The flake builds the plugin for `x86_64-linux`, `aarch64-linux` and `aarch64-darwin`. `packages.<system>.default` contains `lib/`, `package.json` and `cordis.patch.yml`. Its build runs `tsc --noEmit` and the `unit` vitest project, and `checks.<system>.default` is the same package.

```sh
nix build github:jakehemmerle/dsh-mermaid   # result/lib/index.js
nix flake check -L
```

dsh-mermaid README · Nix：As a flake input, use `${dsh-mermaid.packages.${system}.default}/lib/index.js` as the `name` in the profile patch row above. After a `pnpm-lock.yaml` change, update `hash` in `nix/package.nix` with the value Nix reports.

dsh-mermaid README · Nix：CI (`.github/workflows/nix.yml`) runs `nix flake check -L` on Linux and macOS runners, so the package build with its tsc + unit checks and the DSH-seam contract check is exercised on both OSes. The real-client web/TUI suites need the pinned `dsh web`, `dsh-TUI` and Nix Chromium of the flake devShell, so they run locally or in the repo environment (`nix run .#e2e`).

dsh-mermaid README · Limitations：- The plugin depends on DSH `CodeBlock` internals: the `.md-code-block`, `[data-code-block-banner]` and `[data-code-block-content]` hooks, and the React fiber props `{ code, lang, streaming }`. If DSH changes them, the plugin finds no fences and you see the stock code block. Nothing breaks.
- The diagram replaces the code view only visually. React still owns and renders the code block. The plugin adds a single container as the last child of the card and a single button in the header actions.
- `lib/client.mermaid.js` is about 5 MB (about 1.5 MB gzipped), because the full mermaid build is bundled, including elk/cytoscape/katex. It loads once, on demand.
